description: The amendment check handed a range with no commits in it. -ReplayBase/-ReplayTip (014 plan D2c) are the supported way to hand the check an explicit range, and HEAD..HEAD is the empty one: rev-list yields nothing, so the check returns having graded no commit and says so. The line matters because the alternative - returning silently - is GAP-027's shape inside the check that grades amendments. Differs from the pass direction in one argument (plan D10).
